skill.summary: Use for creative agencies, design studios, and content teams — project management, client communication, creative briefs, review workflows, content calendars...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: streamlined creative operations blueprint for agencies and content teams.

- Provides project management templates including creative briefs, project tracking, and status roll-ups
- Defines review & approval workflows for internal and client-facing deliverables
- Introduces structured client communication protocols and feedback request processes
- Outlines detailed content calendar planning and content production pipelines
- Offers copywriting guidance, including headline generation, A/B testing, and CTA best practices
- Emphasizes brand guideline management and asset organization through living references
